mapper.sql: x.id, x.recipient_phone_snapshot AS recipient_phone, x.recipient_country_iso2_snapshot AS recipient_country_iso2, COALESCE(x.account_id, last_rejection.account_id) AS account_id, CASE WHEN x.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN x.sender_phone_snapshot ELSE last_sender.account_phone_snapshot END AS sender_phone, AS sender_country_iso2, x.send_status AS status_code, CASE WHEN x.send_status = 6 AND x.fail_code = 'TASK_STOPPED' AND last_rejection.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN last_rejection.reason_code ELSE x.fail_code END AS fail_code, x.fail_reason, CASE x.send_status WHEN 3 THEN x.sent_at WHEN 4 THEN x.delivered_at WHEN 5 THEN x.read_at WHEN 6 THEN x.failed_at WHEN 7 THEN x.failed_at ELSE NULL END AS status_at
CASE WHEN x.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN x.sender_country_iso2_snapshot ELSE last_sender.sender_country_iso2_snapshot END

FROM hyperlink_task_recipient x LEFT JOIN hyperlink_recipient_sender_rejection last_rejection ON last_rejection.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND last_rejection.recipient_id = x.id AND x.account_id IS NULL AND x.send_status IN (1, 6) AND x.fail_code IN ('WA_ACK_REJECTED_463', 'TASK_STOPPED') AND last_rejection.account_id = ( SELECT rejection.account_id FROM hyperlink_recipient_sender_rejection rejection WHERE rejection.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND rejection.recipient_id = x.id AND rejection.reason_code = 'WA_ACK_REJECTED_463' ORDER BY rejection.created_at DESC, rejection.account_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN hyperlink_task_account_usage last_sender ON last_sender.tenant_id = x.tenant_id AND last_sender.hyperlink_task_id = x.hyperlink_task_id AND last_sender.account_id = last_rejection.account_id
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.task_name, r.recipient_total, r.send_total, r.success_num, r.delivered_num, r.read_num, r.fail_num AS failed_num, r.fail_404_num AS unregistered_num, r.used_account_count, r.invalid_account_count, r.click_uv_num, r.click_total, r.actual_concurrency, r.execution_duration_sec, r.run_status, r.active_since_at, r.metrics_updated_at, r.first_visit_at, r.last_visit_at FROM hyperlink_task t JOIN hyperlink_task_runtime r ON r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND r.hyperlink_task_id = t.id WHERE t.id = #{taskId}

SELECT
WHERE ORDER BY x.id
DESC ASC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
